snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls Online – Welcome to Seasons
snippet.description:
The new age of The Elder Scrolls Online is about to begin! Discover new and more varied adventures and stories, enjoy new ways to earn rewards, and experience an ESO always evolving with player-focused additions, changes, and improvements. It all begins with Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk, live from April 2 until July 8, 2026. 

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TESOnline
Instagram: https://instagram.com/elderscrollsonline

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Sexual Themes, Use of Alcohol, and Violence. Online interactions not rated by the ESRB.
